newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle lower, mixed spread selling.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle lower, mixed spread selling.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures retraced Monday's gains to close the session weaker amid mixed selling focused on the spreads, traders said.
The January contract closed down 3.05 to 101.25, having ranged from 103.00 to 101.00. The back months finished 4.15 to 1.70 lower.
Despite today's losses, analysts said the marekt remains oversold from a technical point of view.
Fundamentally, the outlook is mixed, said Merrill Lynch analyst Judith Ganes. While near-term supplies are somewhat tight, demand is also uncertain, she said.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture estimated the 1996/97 Florida crop at 220 million 90-lb boxes.
